title: Uttarakhand Tour Package
overview: The ultimate Garhwal & Kumaon getaway: experience thrilling Grade-III white water rafting in Rishikesh, attend the divine sunset Ganga Aarti at Triveni Ghat, take leisurely strolls on the Mall Road in Mussoorie, and embark on an open 4x4 Jeep Safari in Jim Corbett National Park.
highlights: 16 km White Water River Rafting through Shivpuri rapids with cliff jumping
Soulful sunset Ganga Aarti at Parmarth Niketan / Triveni Ghat
Open 4x4 Jeep Safari in Jim Corbett National Park (Bijrani / Jhirna zone)
Scenic Kempty Falls & Gun Hill cable car in Mussoorie
Stay in luxury riverside glamping tents & jungle wilderness lodges
inclusions: 5 Nights accommodation in 3★/4★ luxury resorts & riverside camps
16 km River Rafting session with certified river guides & safety gear
1 Open 4x4 Jeep Safari in Jim Corbett with naturalist guide & park permits
Dedicated private Sedan/Innova for all transfers and sightseeing
exclusions: Personal expenses, cafe visits, and adventure activities not mentioned above

itinerary.title: Delhi to Rishikesh & Sunset Ganga Aarti
itinerary.description: Morning pickup from Delhi/NCR or Dehradun Airport and drive to Rishikesh. Check in to your riverside resort. In the evening, witness the iconic sunset Ganga Aarti ceremony.
itinerary.morningActivity: Drive via Delhi-Meerut expressway to Rishikesh
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Check-in to resort and explore Ram Jhula / Lakshman Jhula
itinerary.eveningActivity: Spiritual Ganga Aarti ceremony with floating lamps

itinerary.title: White Water Rafting & Cliff Jumping
itinerary.description: Gear up for an exhilarating 16 km white water rafting expedition tackling rapids like Roller Coaster, Golf Course, and Club House. Enjoy cliff jumping and body surfing.
itinerary.morningActivity: Safety briefing and 16 km rafting from Shivpuri
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Cafe hopping at Little Buddha Cafe or Beatles Ashram
itinerary.eveningActivity: Bonfire by the river stream at your camp

itinerary.title: Rishikesh to Mussoorie ("Queen of the Hills")
itinerary.description: Scenic hill drive to Mussoorie. Visit Kempty Falls and enjoy the cool mountain mist. Take a cable car to Gun Hill for panoramic views of Doon Valley and Himalayan ranges.
itinerary.morningActivity: Drive from Rishikesh up to Mussoorie
itinerary.eveningActivity: Stroll along the historic Mall Road and Library Bazaar
itinerary.stay: Fortune Resort Grace / Jaypee Residency 4★, Mussoorie

itinerary.title: Mussoorie to Jim Corbett National Park
itinerary.description: Drive down from Mussoorie to the wilderness fringes of Jim Corbett National Park. Check in to your nature lodge by the Kosi River.
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Check in to Corbett resort & Garjiya Devi temple visit
itinerary.eveningActivity: Nature walk along Kosi River and wildlife documentary screening
itinerary.stay: Corbett River Creek / The Den Resort 4★, Jim Corbett

itinerary.title: Jim Corbett Open 4x4 Jeep Safari
itinerary.description: Early morning open 4x4 Gypsy safari into the dense Sal forests of Bijrani/Jhirna zone to track Royal Bengal Tigers, Asiatic elephants, spotted deer, and rare birds.
itinerary.morningActivity: Dawn 4x4 Jeep Safari with forest naturalist
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Corbett Waterfall visit and Corbett Museum in Kaladhungi
itinerary.eveningActivity: Barbecue dinner and leisure by the resort pool
itinerary.stay: Corbett River Creek / The Den Resort 4★, Jim Corbett

itinerary.title: Corbett to Delhi / Dehradun Departure
itinerary.description: After a relaxed breakfast, drive back to Delhi or Dehradun Airport for your onward journey with unforgettable mountain memories.
itinerary.afternoonActivity: Highway drive back to Delhi Airport / Railway Station
